description: The bar chart, titled “Recall@10,” visually compares the performance of four different system configurations on a retrieval metric, with the vertical axis representing Recall@10 values ranging from 0.1 to 0.4 in increments of 0.1. The horizontal axis lists the four configurations: “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking,” each represented by a distinct 3D-style bar angled slightly backward. The “Ours” bar, colored orange, is the tallest, reaching approximately 0.37, indicating the highest Recall@10. The other three bars, all in blue, are progressively shorter: “- critiquing” reaches about 0.33, “- scoring” is around 0.24, and “- ranking” is approximately 0.31. The chart suggests that removing any of the three components (critiquing, scoring, or ranking) degrades performance relative to the full “Ours” system, with the “- scoring” variant showing the most significant drop. The bars are not sorted by height, and no additional annotations or error bars are present. The overall layout is tilted for a pseudo-3D effect, with gridlines extending diagonally to aid value estimation.
